address: via A. Del Verrocchio 8r, Florence, 50122, Italy
bio: An elegant room – almost a private living room – and pleasantly friendly service are the outline of a cuisine that focuses on great flavours, following a round-up of now-iconic dishes that enhance the taste of the house and the traditions of the area. Among the starters, the Vassoio del Cibrèo is highly recommended. Please note: you can only order à la carte,...
